steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each missed SLA is matched to an improvement, and each improvement to an owner.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: SLA missed with no improvement
findings.fix: Set the improvement and its date

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] sla-q2.md:12  SLA missed with no improvement.
       Fix: Set the improvement and its date.
[medium] improvement-2.md:19  Improvement with no owner.
       Fix: Assign an owner.
[low] owners.csv:26  Quarter with no review.
       Fix: Hold the review.
Not checked: The client's own priorities.
pros: Checks an SLA missed with no improvement, and an improvement with no owner.
cons: Not checked: The client's own priorities.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-service-review skill on the records for this review.
